argonCombatHud.Name: Enable Argon Combat HUD compatibility
argonCombatHud.Hint: Provides WFRP4e panels, actions, movement, weapon sets, and actor configuration for Argon. Requires an enabled Argon - Combat HUD module and a reload when changed.

paperDoll.Name: Enable Paper Doll compatibility
paperDoll.Hint: Synchronizes WFRP4e equipment, validates slots, and adds WFRP4e tooltips for Paper Doll. Requires an enabled Paper Doll module and a reload when changed.

paperDollArgonBridge.Name: Enable Paper Doll–Argon equipment bridge
paperDollArgonBridge.Hint: Shows Paper Doll ready and quick-use items on Argon and copies Paper Doll's physical hand slots into the active Argon weapon set. Requires both features and a reload when changed.

ArgonCombatItemPatterns.Name: Argon combat item patterns
ArgonCombatItemPatterns.Hint: Comma, semicolon, or line separated item-name patterns for the HUD Items action menu. Use * as a wildcard, such as *Draught* or *Potion*.

WeaponSets.Label: Switch WFRP equipment with weapon sets
WeaponSets.Hint: When enabled, selecting an Argon weapon set equips that set's weapons and unequips weapons from the other Argon sets.
